comment: Where the Python runtime comes from. One copy, because two readers need it: src/pyodide/runtime.ts
and scripts/probe-nblast.mjs, which has no way to import TypeScript.
Both hosts were checked for CORS rather than assumed. jsdelivr answers every request with
access-control-allow-origin: *. files.pythonhosted.org answers with it only when the request
carries an Origin header - a bare curl -I shows no CORS headers at all and reads as a host that
would block a browser, which it is not. Same shape as the /api/roimeshes HEAD-vs-GET finding.
To self-host instead: drop the wheel in public/ and set fastcoreWheel to a BASE_URL-relative
path. It is 1.1 MB, against the ~10 MB of CPython and numpy that would still come from the CDN,
so hosting the algorithm and borrowing the runtime is a defensible middle.
